research_question: Do named software-design principles create an advice prior that persists against moderator evidence, and can an evidence-conditioned rival representation recover reversal or abstention?

novelty_kill.ATAM_CBAM: Already model multi-quality tradeoffs and architecture alternatives; EvoNOMOS may not claim novelty for tradeoff-awareness alone.
novelty_kill.Parnas_information_hiding: Already conditions decomposition on difficult/likely-to-change decisions; EvoNOMOS may not claim novelty for volatility-sensitive modularization alone.
novelty_kill.Baldwin_Clark_Sullivan_DSM_real_options: Already formalize modularity value under uncertainty and future design options; EvoNOMOS may not claim novelty for context-dependent modularity value alone.
novelty_kill.architectural_tactics_ADD: Already map tactics/design decisions to quality attributes and tradeoffs; EvoNOMOS may not claim novelty for quality-conditioned tactic selection alone.
novelty_kill.surviving_candidate: A revocable empirical design-law layer whose unit is moderator-conditioned rival intervention with vector outcomes, sign reversal/failure boundary, and explicit abstention, plus direct measurement of named-principle priors in LLM advice.

arms.CONTEXT_ONLY: No design-principle names. Choose among concrete rival actions and ABSTAIN.
arms.NAMED_PRINCIPLE_PRIME: Same evidence and rivals, but explicitly names the associated SOLID principle before choice.
arms.EVIDENCE_CONDITIONED: No maxim authority. Presents moderator fields, falsifiers and instruction to choose a rival only when evidence supports a predicted outcome channel; otherwise ABSTAIN.

metrics.principle_pull: P(principle-congruent action | named prime) - P(principle-congruent action | context only), stratified by APPLY vs REVERSE/ABSTAIN cells.
metrics.evidence_sensitivity: Probability that choice changes in the correct direction across paired moderator flips.
metrics.advice_reversal: For paired cells, whether APPLY becomes rival/ABSTAIN when the decisive moderator flips.
metrics.unsupported_maxim_rate: Rate of principle-congruent action on cells precommitted as REVERSE/ABSTAIN.
metrics.abstention_calibration: Rate of ABSTAIN on cells whose sufficient boundary/falsifier makes the named principle inapplicable.
metrics.name_mention_leak: Any unsolicited SOLID/principle-name mention in CONTEXT_ONLY output.

primary_contrast: NAMED_PRINCIPLE_PRIME versus EVIDENCE_CONDITIONED on REVERSE/ABSTAIN cells
